ForensicModels - burglary, forensic and police props for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared October 14, 2026; corrected October 15, 2026 (glove tag removed from the smoothness and normal maps,
searchlight, binder and hammer authors recorded); LOD variants of four models added October 15, 2026.
Poly Haven batch 2 (12 more models, three colour maps rewritten, four wordmarks painted out) added October 24, 2026.
Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

Everything in this folder is either CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven) or project-owned original work.
No attribution is required for any file; the credits below are a courtesy. Commercial use,
modification and redistribution are allowed. Exact mirror paths, commits and SHA-256 hashes
of every source file and every shipped file are in sources.json.

CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

===============================================================================
1. Poly Haven 3D models (CC0 1.0)
===============================================================================
Publisher licence: https://polyhaven.com/license, read from the site source
github.com/Poly-Haven/polyhaven.com @ b1a6aa13afc03ae00860f6ac5fe6d5daf8e95356,
public/locales/en/license.json:
  "All assets (HDRIs, textures and 3D models) on this site are the original work of Poly
   Haven staff, or artists who willingly and directly donate/sell their work to Poly Haven."
  "Our assets are all licensed as CC0 ..."
  "You can use our assets for any purpose, including commercial work."
  "You do not need to give credit or attribution when using them (although it is appreciated)."
  "You can redistribute them, share them around, include them when sharing your own work,
   or even in a product you sell."

polyhaven.com itself cannot be reached from the build container, so the unmodified 1K/2K glTF
files were taken from public GitHub repositories that ship them under their Poly Haven names
(each repository's own licence covers its code only; the asset files are the CC0 originals).
Each repository credits Poly Haven/CC0 in the file named below, and where possible the files
were checked byte-for-byte against a second, independent mirror.

Changes made here (all files):
  - Converted glTF -> OBJ/MTL with Tools/glb_to_obj.py (--ground: lowest point at y = 0, centred in x/z),
    metres and authored orientation kept; OBJ numbers rounded to 0.1 mm.
  - Base colour -> <Name>_Color.jpg; nor_gl -> <Name>_Normal.jpg; ARM (R = AO, G = roughness, B = metal)
    -> <Name>_MetallicSmoothness.png (R = metallic, A = 1 - roughness). Some maps reduced to 512 px or 1K.
  - Glass sub-materials (magnifier lens, camera window, searchlight lens) written as MTL constants.
  - Security camera, searchlight, stone and binder decimated to 9,001 / 8,999 / 4,999 / 8,000 triangles
    (UV-exact decimation, Source~/decimate_exact.py).
  - Product-style lettering painted out of four colour maps so no brand-like text remains:
    "Q-TECH" (measuring tape label), "FocusSpy" (camera badge), "YOKI'S" (glove tag), "SENTINEL IQ-4"
    (searchlight plate) - Source~/delabel.py.
  - The woven "YOKI'S" glove tag also showed in the roughness channel (WorkGloves_MetallicSmoothness.png alpha)
    and as a raised outline in WorkGloves_Normal.jpg. Both maps were rebuilt from the unmodified 2K ARM and
    normal maps with the tag area filled from the surrounding knit (Source~/delabel_glove_maps.py,
    October 15, 2026), so the tag is now gone from the colour, smoothness and normal maps.
  - OfficeNotepads: the ten pads of the showcase grid re-laid as a floor scatter (Source~/scatter_groups.py).
  - LOD variants (October 15, 2026): Crowbar_LOD1.obj and Crowbar_LOD2.obj, Sledgehammer_LOD1.obj and
    Sledgehammer_LOD2.obj, FlatheadScrewdriver_LOD1.obj and FlatheadScrewdriver_LOD2.obj were decimated from
    Crowbar.obj, Sledgehammer.obj and FlatheadScrewdriver.obj by the project-owned Source~/make_lods.py (every
    vertex and UV is an original one of the source; nothing new added). They use the original MTL files and maps.
    These CC0 derivatives stay CC0 1.0 (same authors as their source models).
  - Batch 2 (October 24, 2026; Source~/relabel_ph2.py, Source~/build_ph2.py):
    LiftingTapeRoll: medical_tape scaled x2 (tape width 0.05 m), mesh split into lifting_tape (d 0.9) and tape_core
      materials, colour map rebuilt (clear off-white tape, kraft core), tape smoothness raised.
    ReagentSprayBottle: all_purpose_cleaner body recoloured pink -> white, the "Planis" / "SUPER CLEANER+" labels painted
      out and plain "LATENT BLOOD REAGENT" labels drawn (fictional text, DejaVu Sans, no pictograms, no brand).
    DentalStoneBag: cement_bag colour map rebuilt from scratch as plain paper with a "DENTAL STONE / forensic casting
      grade / 11 kg" print; the "CEMENT" artwork and its logo are gone.
    EvidenceBox 16,952 -> 5,999, Spectacles 11,810 -> 9,000, DroppedWatch 10,390 -> 9,002 triangles (UV-exact,
      Source~/decimate_exact.py); BurglarToolbox lid and handle decimated per group, 14,228 -> 9,994.
    Wordmarks painted out: "STEEL..." roundel (metal_toolbox), "LANSTEY" (screwdriver), "TROP (R)" (vintage_lighter),
      "RISTO" and the case-back engraving (digital_wrist_watch). Generic function labels on the watch were kept.
    CigaretteButt: one cigarette node of cigarette_case cut to 25 mm, capped and crushed; the case itself is not shipped.
    ReagentBottles: six nodes (three bottles with stoppers) of chemistry_set extracted and decimated 3,584 -> 2,897;
      the rest of the set is not shipped.
    These CC0 derivatives stay CC0 1.0 (same authors as their source models).

Voluntary credit line: "3D models by Alexander Otterbeck, Dylan Guzman, Tics, Dylan Detwiller, Antanas Kep,
Yann Kervran, Satyaki Mandal, Dario Barresi, Rico Cilliers, Benny Weimer, ProgrammerOnCoffee,
Kuutti Siitonen, Nazar Borodavka, Elijah Cragg, DaDrood, Ulan Cabanilla, Miroslav Turura, PierreB3D,
Rahul Chaudhary, Mateusz Sadek, Enrique Martín, Slinc, Sean Buckley, Adrian C and Jiří Ptáček (polyhaven.com, CC0)."

===============================================================================
2. Project-owned original work
===============================================================================
Made for this repository on October 14, 2026 with Python (numpy, Pillow, trimesh); procedural
geometry and procedural textures only, no third-party models, photos or textures. Project-owned;
the project may use, change and redistribute them without restriction (treat them like CC0).

  Evidence and documents: EvidenceBagPaper, EvidenceBagPlastic, EvidenceMarkerTent, EvidenceMarkerCone,
      ForensicScaleL, PaperSheetForm, ScatteredPapers, ForensicPapers_Color.jpg
  Forensic kit: FingerprintBrush, FingerprintPowderJar, NitrileGloveBox, ForensicCase, TacticalFlashlight,
      UVTorch, PoliceRadio, CameraTripod, ShoePrintCast
  LOD variants (October 15, 2026): ForensicCase_LOD1.obj, ForensicCase_LOD2.obj, decimated from ForensicCase.obj
      by Source~/make_lods.py; project-owned like ForensicCase.
  Police: PoliceCap, PoliceBarrier
  Burglary: BrickHalf, DuffelBag, Balaclava
  Glass: GlassShardsLarge, GlassShardsScatter, TemperedGlassCrumbs, GlassCrackDecal_ColorAlpha.png,
      GlassCrackDecal_Normal.png
  Source~/*.py: the generator and conversion scripts (Unity ignores folders ending in "~"). Source~/make_lods.py
      is a copy of the project's own StreetModels LOD tool (Source~/make_lods.py there).
  CSI consumables and evidence (October 24, 2026; Source~/proc_csi.py, Source~/assemble_csi.py): MagneticWand,
      GelLifterBlack, GelLifterWhite, BackingCardWhite, BackingCardBlack, LiftCardWithPrint, HingeLifterBlack,
      HingeLifterWhite, SwabTube, SwabOpen, SwabBox, DistilledWaterAmpoule, KMTestKit, MikrosilTube, MikrosilCatalyst,
      MixingSpatula, ToolMarkCast, MixingBowlRubber, CastingFrame, EvidenceTag, EvidenceLabelRoll, BiohazardBinSmall,
      SteppingPlate, OrangeGoggles, FaceMask, ShoeCoverPair, HairFibreSpecimen, FibreTuft, ElectrostaticLiftFilm, and
      the decal textures FootwearDustMark_ColorAlpha.png / _Normal.png and PryMark_ColorAlpha.png / _Normal.png.
      Project-owned original work like the rest of this section; procedural geometry and textures only. The ridge
      art on LiftCardWithPrint_Color.jpg is composited from the project's own synthetic SurfaceDecals/
      Fingerprints_Atlas.png (no real person). The biohazard pictogram is an own drawing of the generic public-domain
      symbol. The short Arabic lines were rasterised with the project's Noto Sans Arabic
      (Prototype/ThirdParty/Fonts/Arabic, SIL Open Font License; glyph images only, no font file is shipped here).

Printed text on labels, forms and markers was rasterised with the DejaVu fonts installed on the build
machine (Bitstream Vera / DejaVu licence; only glyph images are used, no font file is shipped). Every
name, case number, shop name ("Aurel & Finch", the project's fictional shop), police force ("City
Police") and product description is fictional. No real brand, logo, badge or person is depicted; the
police cap badge is a generic eight-point star without lettering.
